ns2:section.sectionText: Except for occasional Wednesday evening exams/quizzes held at 7 pm (CST) the entire course is asynchronous with no mandatory meeting times. ALL ACCY 202 SECTIONS RESTRICTED TO SPECIFIED MAJORS. ALL OTHERS MAY ENROLL MONDAY, DECEMBER 14, 2020 AT 10:00AM IF SPACE IS AVAILABLE Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
